data.one_liner: A place picker package for Google Maps fully written in Dart for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides common operations for place picking, places autocomplete, current location, and nearby places using Google Maps. Supports free native geocoding as an option to reduce API costs.
use_when: You need a complete map-based place picker in your Flutter app.
You want to allow users to search for places, view nearby locations, and pick coordinates using Google Maps.
avoid_when: You require an entirely custom map interface built with alternative mapping engines like flutter_map without Google Maps dependencies.
strengths: Includes autocomplete, nearby places, and my location out of the box
Supports free native geocoding to reduce Google API billing costs
Cross-platform support for Android, iOS, and Web
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific API key configuration and enabling multiple Google Cloud APIs
Web usage requires setting up a proxy server to bypass CORS restrictions for Google Places API
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining a Google Maps API key, enabling Maps SDK for Android/iOS, Places API, and Geocoding API, configuring AndroidManifest.xml, AppDelegate, Info.plist, and index.html for web.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need raw Google Maps integration and want to build a fully custom place picking interface from scratch.
